- **Perk-based ammo refund** - vanilla arrows and bolts have a chance to be returned after projectile impact based on Archery perk level

Starting in v1.3.0, vanilla arrows and crossbow bolts can be refunded after projectile impact. This is a pure XML implementation: the ammo is spent normally when fired, then the mod has a chance to add one matching arrow or bolt back to the player's inventory when the projectile impact event fires.

If another mod adds custom arrows or bolts, those custom ammo items will not automatically receive this refund effect. Their item XML needs matching `onProjectileImpact` refund triggers and matching `gameevents.xml` AddItems events, following the same pattern used for the vanilla arrows and bolts.

The mod adds 10 disassembly recipes — one for each arrow and crossbow bolt type. Craft a bundle from 30 arrows or bolts on a **Workbench** to recover **75% of the original materials**. Recipes are unlocked after reading all 7 volumes of **Ranger's Guide to Archery**.

requirement_mentions.excerpt: # ANONYMIZED_AUTHOR SCore Configuration
Curated SCore settings override for Smorgasbord.
Built against: **0-SCore 3.0.8.709**
## Install
Place this folder in the 7 Days to Die `Mods` folder alongside `0-SCore`.
The `ZZZ_` prefix is intentional so this mod loads after SCore.
## Optional settings included but commented out
## SCore update checklist
When SCore updates:
1. Replace/update the `0-SCore` folder.
2. Do **not** edit SCore directly.
3. Keep this patch mod enabled after SCore.
4. Open the new SCore `Config/blocks.xml`.
This mod is intentionally XML-only. It does not include SCore DLLs or any SCore assets.

requirement_mentions.excerpt: **IZY Classic** is the official updated version of the IZY-All in One Gun Pack v5.1.3 modpack. Easier to install, to update and to maintain, it brings the classic weapon line-up to 7 Days To Die v3.0.
## What to install?
Before installing you need to download first the following files:
1. IZY Classic - Core (see [Files section]([external-url])).
**IZY Classic will not work without these required mods!**
## How to install IZY Classic manually?
3. Download the files listed in the **What to install?** section above.
## How to install IZY Classic automatically using Smörgåsbord?
IZY Classic and the required mods are available on [Smörgåsbord]([external-url]), a Wabbajack ModOrganizer2 ModList. Find out more about Smörgåsbord [here]([external-url]).
- 7 Days to Die v3.0 and later. The mod is not compatible with 7 Days to Die v2.6.
- All the required mods must be installed on the client and on the server.
**Before reporting an issue**:
1. Make sure that you have followed the installation instructions on this page and that you installed ALL the required mods.

2. If an issue appeared AFTER you added another mod to your game, remove that mod and see if the issue persists. Mod conflicts are NOT bugs. Talk to the author of that mod and let him know politely about the conflict.
3. If an issue appeared AFTER you changed the vanilla Sandbox settings, tell us about these settings in your post.
- Before asking for help, ensure that you have followed the installation instructions on this page. Always provide a full log via a link to pastebin.com.
- IZY Classic is NOT compatible with most overhaul mods. Instructions to convert Izy Classic to another overhaul will be provided upon request.

- ANONYMIZED_AUTHOR is using Izy Classic with over 530+ others mods in Smörgåsbord. However, that doesn't mean it's compatible with everything. Other weapon, progression, and ammo mods may cause errors when combined with Izy Classic.

requirement_mentions.excerpt: - Vehicle mods now install into the vehicle mod slots instead of being redirected into vehicle storage.
- Updated vehicle mod detection to use real vehicle modifier install tags such as vstorage, vengine, vfuel, vlight, vseat, vplow, and varmor.
- Improved compatibility with vanilla vehicle mods and modded vehicle modifier entries that use the normal vehicle install-tag system.
- Fixed the vehicle UI breaking or hiding the mod-slot area after installing a vehicle mod with Shift+Click.
- Removed an overly broad vehicle window refresh after vehicle mod installation so the mod-slot panel remains stable.
- Fixed a cross-page item modification duplication case where installing a mod/attachment could write the modified item onto the attachment page instead of updating the original hidden-page item.
- Fixed the temporary visual ghost of a modified item appearing on the attachment page before closing the modification window.
- Fixed the temporary lock icon that could remain on the attachment page after the modified item visual was redirected back to its original page.
- Fixed page-aware slot lock persistence so old vanilla lock masks can no longer re-lock the first backpack slot after relog when it was manually unlocked.
- Added defensive StackLock unlock capture so the first backpack slot can stay unlocked after relog when the rest of the page is locked.

- Fixed a startup Harmony error on 7 Days to Die 3.0 builds where XUiC_LootWindowGroup.OnOpen no longer exists; the optional loot-window sound fallback now skips safely instead of breaking mod initialization.
- Fixed Take All / Move All from storage, vehicles, and loot containers so matching stacks in the toolbelt are filled before creating a new backpack stack.
- Fixed external UI/backpack layout detection when another mod changes the backpack grid before Adaptive Backpack loads.
- Fixed page-aware slot lock persistence so the top-left slot on page 1 is no longer cleared by incomplete vanilla lock initialization after exit/reload.
- Old empty backend slots are now removed after reducing page count.
- Added optional Shift + Mouse Wheel page switching for the normal backpack.
- Added automatic close behavior after empty Death Backpack Take All.
- Improved immediate UI refresh after Move All and Take All into vehicles and storage containers.
- Vehicle bags now expand to their configured capacity before slot controllers are rebound.
- Fixed drone storage staying active after closing the drone UI.

requirement_mentions.excerpt: > **If you are running a dedicated server, this mod only needs to be installed on the server.**
> Players connecting to the server **do not need to download or install anything** on their game clients — all changes are synced automatically when they join.
> **Why `-0.799` and not `-0.8`?** A slightly adjusted value is used so the in-game thresholds line up with the intended results more reliably after the game applies its own rounding.

Some large overhaul modpacks and total-conversion mods already tune the looting XP branch independently. When they are installed together with this mod the `perc_add` values stack and the final XP will differ from the table above — it could be higher or lower depending on what the other mod adds.
Before combining this mod with a large modpack, search the other mod's `Config/` files for the following patterns:

modlets.description_excerpt: Torch is a 7 Days to Die mod which works to optimize one of the game's most inefficient areas -- the lighting engine. It is designed to improve frame rates and in situtations where there are many lights in an area in game, it does so without compromising on how the game looks.

modlets.name: TorchonHotkey
modlets.description_excerpt: Places torch when you press a hotkey
modlets.author: jucah

requirement_mentions.excerpt: Whether you need to light up a room while fighting off zombies or quickly illuminate a deep mine shaft, this mod streamlines exploration and base building. It is highly configurable through a dedicated in-game UI menu and console commands, allowing you to choose your own hotkey, decide if torches s…

The Torchbearer mod is a comprehensive quality-of-life utility designed to make lighting your way in the world of 7 Days to Die seamless and intuitive. It removes the need to break your flow by opening the inventory, finding your torches, and placing them manually. With a single press of a button,…
At Feet Placement: Instantly drops a torch in the block space at your feet. Ideal for emergencies when you're suddenly plunged into darkness or need immediate light without aiming.
Optional Item Consumption: You decide how you want to play.

Smart Torch Limit (Anti-Clutter): When in the default Consumption mode of 'free'; to keep your world clean and performance high, the mod will only allow the last 10 torches placed via the hotkey to exist at one time. When you place your 11th torch, the 1st one you placed is automatically removed fr…

Fully Integrated In-Game Settings UI: No need to remember every console command! Simply press Escape while in-game and click the new "Mod Options" button to access a dedicated menu where you can easily toggle settings and set your hotkey.

Unified Mod Help System: This mod includes a master help command (z_master_modhelp) that lists the commands and descriptions for all of your installed mods that use this shared help registry system, making it easy to manage multiple mods.
That's it! The mod will load automatically on your next game start. It does not need to be installed on a server for clients to use it.

requirement_mentions.excerpt: This mod is compatible with both V1, V2, V3 and later versions of the game.
FOR INTEGRATION IN THE NEW COSMETICS/WARDROBE SYSTEM YOU HAVE TO INSTALL "LittleRedSonja_CAS" version 1.6.0 or later.
- Fully compatible with the cosmetics system (Requires LittleRedSonja CAS mod 1.4.2 or later for the cosmetic feature).
- Fully compatible with Izayo Weapons (no graphical glitches) and any other weapon pack I am aware of.
- You need to update CAS to version 1.6.0. Not only does it include support for the new Jumsuit, but more important it include additional stability and performance improvements.
- Adds a full version of Fallout Armors, for those who prefer it. Fully compatible and integrated with The Wasteland, Rebirth V1 and V2 and Escape from Tarkov overhaul V1 and V2.

IMPORTANT NOTE: FOR THIS MOD TO BE FULLY FUNCTIONAL WITH REBIRTH OR THE WASTELAND YOU MUST RENAME THE MOD FOLDER TO LOAD AFTER REBIRTH_CORE MOD. This because Rebirth_ Core and The Wasteland mod deletes everything in the armor crafting skill so if this mod loads first the edits would just be deleted.
This mod is compatible with both V1, V2, V3 and later versions of the game.
To verify you have installed the mod correctly, the ModInfo.xml file should be located at Mods\LittleRedSonja_Mumpfy_ArmorPack09_Fallout\ModInfo.xml relative to your 7D2D install folder.
This mod IS NOT Server-Side-Only. Since it adds custom assets it requires installation both in server AND client for multiplayer. For solo player install like any other mod.
FOR INTEGRATION IN THE NEW COSMETICS/WARDROBE SYSTEM YOU HAVE TO INSTALL "LittleRedSonja_CAS" version 1.6.0 or later.

The system works by introducing a degradation mechanic for both crafting tools and the workstations themselves. Instead of a single use-based durability system, this feature makes tools a consumable resource that requires upkeep to continue crafting. It also applies the same logic to the workstatio…

* **Degradation Logic**: The `ItemDegradationHelpers.cs` file contains a suite of helper methods that manage the core degradation logic. This includes checking if an item or block can degrade, calculating its degradation based on properties, and determining if it has reached a "broken" state. The s…
* **Fuel Grid Check**: The `XUiCWorkstationFuelGridTurnOn` patch checks if a tool required for a recipe is degraded before allowing the workstation to turn on.
* **Workstation Queue Check**: The `TileEntityWorkstationHandleRecipeQueue` patch stops the crafting queue if a required tool becomes degraded while crafting is in progress with the window closed.

* **Tool Grid Requirement**: The `XUiCWorkstationToolGridHasRequirement` patch checks the tool grid and blocks crafting if a required tool is degraded, even if the recipe itself has no explicit requirement for a specific tool type.

Starting in v1.3.0, vanilla arrows and crossbow bolts can be refunded after projectile impact. This is a pure XML implementation: the ammo is spent normally when fired, then the mod has a chance to add one matching arrow or bolt back to the player's inventory when the projectile impact event fires.

If another mod adds custom arrows or bolts, those custom ammo items will not automatically receive this refund effect. Their item XML needs matching `onProjectileImpact` refund triggers and matching `gameevents.xml` AddItems events, following the same pattern used for the vanilla arrows and bolts.

The Torchbearer mod is a comprehensive quality-of-life utility designed to make lighting your way in the world of 7 Days to Die seamless and intuitive. It removes the need to break your flow by opening the inventory, finding your torches, and placing them manually. With a single press of a button,…
At Feet Placement: Instantly drops a torch in the block space at your feet. Ideal for emergencies when you're suddenly plunged into darkness or need immediate light without aiming.
Optional Item Consumption: You decide how you want to play.

Smart Torch Limit (Anti-Clutter): When in the default Consumption mode of 'free'; to keep your world clean and performance high, the mod will only allow the last 10 torches placed via the hotkey to exist at one time. When you place your 11th torch, the 1st one you placed is automatically removed fr…

Fully Integrated In-Game Settings UI: No need to remember every console command! Simply press Escape while in-game and click the new "Mod Options" button to access a dedicated menu where you can easily toggle settings and set your hotkey.

Unified Mod Help System: This mod includes a master help command (z_master_modhelp) that lists the commands and descriptions for all of your installed mods that use this shared help registry system, making it easy to manage multiple mods.
That's it! The mod will load automatically on your next game start. It does not need to be installed on a server for clients to use it.
